title: Talks with the Soul
author: Richmond
description:
Talks with the Soul is a podcast for the part of you that knows. 

This isn't for the part of you that performs, explains, and desperately holds everything together. Its for what's waiting underneath all of that. For the one that was here before you learned who to be. 

Every episode opens the same way, with a single line and a breath: this is a sacred space...not a safe space. What follows is not a lecture and not a lesson. It is one voice speaking to one listener, tracing the questions we are usually too busy to ask. Who am I? Why am I afraid? How did I get here? What remains when the noise finally stops? 

Along the way, the voices that spoke the same truth across the ages keep us company. Christian mystics, Zen teachers, Sufi poets, the sages of the Upanishads and more. They are not here as authorities. They are here as witnesses, confirming something you already carry. 

This is not a path toward becoming someone new. It is simply a way back home, to the one you have always been. 

Come as you are. There is nothing here to fix. 

From my soul to yours.

description:

Discover how deeply rooted ideas about money, success, and worth can influence your financial reality—and how changing your belief system can help create a healthier relationship with money and open the door to greater abundance.


Meditate Right breaks the stereotypes surrounding meditation. There is no one-size-fits-all approach to finding stillness. This series explores meditation through the lens of personality, helping you discover practices that complement the way you naturally think, process, focus, and experience the world.


Heal is dedicated to the animals we love and the responsibility we have to care for them. Explore pet health and wellness through both modern veterinary medicine and traditional holistic practices, with conversations designed to help us better understand, love, and care for our animals throughout their lives.


Money. Mind. Healing. Three very different subjects connected by one powerful idea: when you learn to read your own life, you can begin to rewrite it.

title: Wooden Gifts for Design Lovers
author: Eathi Najaf
description:
In the world of design, thoughtful details and well-crafted objects have the power to transform spaces and enrich everyday life. Wooden gifts hold a special place in this landscape. With their warm textures, organic forms, and timeless appeal, they combine functionality with beauty—making them perfect for design lovers who appreciate pieces that both perform and inspire. From heirloom keepsakes to sculptural décor, handcrafted wooden creations elevate interiors while nurturing emotional connection. In this post, we explore transformative wooden gift ideas that resonate with aesthetic sensibilities and design values.

1. The Enduring Allure of Wood in Design

Wood has been central to human creativeexpression for millennia. Its versatility allows it to adapt across styles—from minimal modern to rustic, mid-century, and contemporary art. Unlike synthetic materials, wood ages gracefully; its patina evolves over time, inviting a sense of continuity and lived experience.
For design lovers, wooden objects are not just gifts—they are pieces that tell a story. Whether used as décor or daily tools, well-crafted wooden pieces harmonize with a space, offering warmth and textural contrast to materials like metal, glass, and stone.


2. Keepsakes That Capture Personal Moments

Custom Engraved Memory Boxes

A keepsake box crafted from solid wood—such as walnut, maple, or oak—can hold treasured mementos like photographs, letters, or jewelry. Personalized engraving adds a deeply emotional layer: names, dates, or meaningful quotes transform a beautiful box into a cherished heirloom.
Design lovers will appreciate not only the sentimental value but also the craftsmanship: dovetail joints, hand-rubbed finishes, and meticulous attention to grain direction make such pieces both functional and artistic.

Engraved Photo Frames with a Twist

Photo frames are a classic gift, but wooden frames with custom laser engraving take them to a new level. Rather than a generic design, subtle carved details—like geometric patterns, botanical elements, or bespoke typography—bring a refined, design-centric quality. Choose sustainably sourced wood for an eco-conscious touch.

3. Functional Art: Everyday Pieces That Elevate Interiors

Handcrafted Wooden PlantersPlants and interiors go hand in hand, and wooden planters make the union even more compelling. A planter crafted from cedar or teak—especially with a sculptural form—becomes an art piece in its own right. For design lovers who favor organic interiors, these planters add fluidity and natural rhythm to living spaces.

Pair them with succulents, ferns, or trailing vines for a dynamic interplay between greenery and grain.
Artisanal Cutting Boards & Serving Trays

Every home chef knows the joy of using a beautifully made cutting board. But for design enthusiasts, cutting boards and serving trays are more than kitchen tools—they are statement pieces.

Boards with mixed-wood inlays or geometric patterns become striking centerpieces on countertops or dining tables. They make everyday rituals—chopping herbs, serving cheese, or presenting breakfast in bed—feel elevated. When not in use, they can even serve as artful wall hangings.

4. Sculptural Decor: When Wood Becomes Art

Abstract Wooden SculpturesFor lovers of modern design, abstract wooden sculptures offer a tangible way to introduce organic form into their space. These pieces can range from sleek and minimal to expressive and tactile. Their tactile surfaces and flowing lines provide a contrast to sharper architectural elements, infusing interiors with warmth and movement.

Whether placed on bookshelves, consoles, or mantelpieces, these sculptures act as focal points—sparking curiosity and conversation.

Wooden Wall Art

Wall art doesn’t have to be canvas or print. Wooden relief panels, carved mandalas, or layered wooden wall installations add depth and dimension to flat surfaces. Because wood carries texture and shadow, these pieces change appearance with light throughout the day, engaging the viewer in a subtle, living dialogue.

Design lovers will appreciate the careful interplay between negative space and form, as well as the harmony with existing materials like plaster, brick, or metal.

5. Functional and Stylish Accessories

Hand-Turned Wooden Bowls and VesselsHand-turned wooden bowls and vessels are deceptively simple—they function as holders for fruit, keys, or decorative objects, yet their curved silhouettes and natural grain make them design focal points. Woods like olive, cherry, and ash add distinct color tones that complement varied palettes.

These pieces reflect the beauty of imperfection: slight variations and asymmetrical forms reveal the maker’s hand, reinforcing the connection between object and artisan.

Designer Wooden Clocks

A clock is both functional and decorative. Wooden clocks with minimalist dials, geometric forms, or contrasting wood accents appeal to design lovers who prize subtle sophistication. Mounted on living room walls or displayed on desks, they keep time while anchoring spaces with balance and rhythm.

Opt for sustainably harvested wood and non-toxic finishes for a gift that aligns with both aesthetic and ethical values.

6. Personalized Decor that Tells a Story

Custom Wooden Nameplates & Signs

Personalized wooden nameplates—whether for home offices, entryways, or bedrooms—combine utility with bespoke design. Laser-cut typography in classic serif or modern sans-serif fonts creates a statement piece that feels both personal and artful.Add layered wood elements, painted accents, or engraved motifs for an added design punch.

Decorative Wooden Candlesticks and Holders

Wooden candlesticks, either minimal or ornate, add warmth and ambiance to interiors. Choose tapered, turned forms for classic elegance or asymmetrical shapes for a more contemporary look. When paired with beeswax or soy candles, these holders encourage calm rituals—dinner gatherings, evening reflections, or quiet mornings.

7. Sustainable Design: A Gift with Environmental Integrity

One of the defining qualities of wooden gifts is their potential for sustainability. When wood is responsibly sourced—from reclaimed timber, salvaged barnwood, or FSC-certified forests—design lovers receive not just a beautiful object but an ethical one.

Sustainable wooden pieces emphasize longevity over disposability: handcrafted objects meant to be used, treasured, and passed down. This commitment to durability echoes design principles that value thoughtful materiality and mindful consumption.

8. Craftsmanship and Customization: The Heart of Transformative Gifts

What elevates wooden gifts above ordinary décor is craftsmanship. True design lovers recognize and value the nuance of skillful making. Each handcrafted wooden piece—whether turned on a lathe, carved with chisels, or assembled through precision joinery—bears the imprint of human intention.

Customization amplifies this impact. Personalized wood gifts signal a deep understanding of the recipient’s tastes, lifestyle, and aesthetic values. The result is not just an object, but a meaningful experience—one that connects giver, maker, and receiver through design.

9. Curating Wooden Gifts for Design LoversWhen choosing a wooden gift for a design enthusiast, consider:
  • Function + Form: Will the piece serve a practical purpose while expressing aesthetic value?

  • Material Quality: Does the wood’s grain, finish, and tactile quality align with refined design sensibilities?

  • Personal Meaning: Does customization or personal resonance add depth?

  • Space Integration: Will it complement existing interiors or become a compelling focal point?

  • Sustainable Values: Is the piece responsibly sourced and built to last?

A thoughtful wooden gift is an investment in beauty, functionality, and emotional resonance—making daily life feel more designed, intentional, and joyful.

title: The Words and Magic of Music in The Rings of Power
author: Phillip
description: Everyone loves Bear McCreary's score to the Rings of Power. I’ll let you into a secret. Bear writes his music in code. Let me help you decode the soundtracks to The Rings of Power in this educational guide. Each character, place or idea in Bear’s scores has a recognisable melody or tune that sets it apart from all other characters and he has a pattern or blueprint that he uses for many of his themes. In interviews, Bear described how he sat down at the beginning and wrote all of the themes before he actually started to score the episodes. Part of this process was talking with the show runners about the trajectory of characters so that he could include at the inception those future ideas as musical developments. Each podcast I will examine one musical theme and discover what the music is telling about the character, the place or the idea. Some of these are mind-blowing. Join me in a journey through Bear’s score so you can better understand what is happening and get greater enjoyment from the show as this window gives you a glimpse into the hidden areas of the stories.

description:
Are you a high-performing woman working in healthcare, emergency services or another demanding leadership role? Maybe you can handle the crisis, make the difficult decision and be the person everyone relies on, but when the workday ends, you have a much harder time leaving it behind.


Women Under Pressure is a podcast for ambitious women who want to succeed at a high level without sacrificing their mental health, physical health, relationships or the rest of their lives in the process.


Hosted by Kristen Plake, a licensed trauma therapist and founder of Frontline Wellness Group, the show explores what demanding careers ask of women and how to build a life that can sustain both ambition and wellbeing.


Kristen brings more than 15 years of experience in healthcare and mental health to these conversations, along with a personal understanding of frontline life from growing up as the daughter of a police officer. Her clinical work focuses on trauma, burnout and the cumulative effects of careers that require people to repeatedly manage crisis, responsibility and uncertainty.


Through practical solo episodes and honest conversations with experts and women doing demanding work, Women Under Pressure goes beyond traditional conversations about stress management and self-care. You'll learn more about how your experiences affect you, why it can be so difficult to switch off even when the crisis is over, and what can help you recover without asking you to become less driven or walk away from work that matters to you.


You’ll also hear answers to questions such as:

👉 Why can't I switch off after work?

👉 Why am I exhausted even when I'm still performing well?

👉 How do I stop bringing work home with me?

👉 What are the signs of burnout in high-performing women?

👉 How does trauma exposure affect me over time?

👉 How can I regulate my nervous system after a difficult shift or high-pressure day?


Follow Women Under Pressure wherever you listen to podcasts and learn how to keep pursuing the work and ambitions that matter to you without sacrificing yourself in the process.


Learn more about Kristen and Frontline Wellness Group at frontlinewellnessgroup.com.

title: Closure is not always necessary
author: Rafique
description:
Why Closure Is Not Always Necessary

Closure is often seen as an important part of moving forward, but it is not always necessary. Sometimes, healing comes from accepting that there may never be a clear explanation, apology, or satisfying ending. Waiting for closure can keep us attached to situations, people, or questions that are no longer within our control.

Instead, we can choose to create our own sense of peace by accepting what happened, learning from the experience, and allowing ourselves to move forward without having every question answered. Not every story needs a perfect ending; sometimes, letting go without closure is itself a form of closure.

description:
Welcome to Quantum on the Treadmill.

Over the past few months, I’ve been trying to understand quantum physics—and honestly, it hasn’t been easy. I’m not a physicist, and equations aren’t naturally how I think. Instead, I ask strange questions: Why whole numbers? What is Planck’s constant? And why did anyone believe these ideas in the first place?

Most of these questions came to me while walking on the treadmill. So I began using AI to challenge my assumptions, explore the history, and help me make sense of the science.

Then I realized I could automate almost the entire creative process without stepping off the treadmill—from capturing the conversation and organizing the ideas to creating the script, audio, and visuals.

This series is an experiment in learning, exercise, AI, and curiosity.

title: The Power of Digital Marketing
author: John
description:
🎙️ Podcast: The Power of Digital Marketing

Welcome back to the podcast! Today, we're talking about one of the most important parts of growing a business in 2026: digital marketing.

The way people discover brands has completely changed. Customers are no longer influenced only by traditional advertisements. They discover businesses through YouTube, podcasts, social media, search engines, online communities, and valuable content.

The key is not simply to sell. The key is to provide value. When you educate, entertain, or solve a problem for your audience, you build trust. And trust is what turns viewers into customers.

Consistency is also extremely important. You don't need to become viral overnight. Focus on creating useful content regularly and understanding what your audience actually wants.

AI is also changing marketing by helping businesses research audiences, generate ideas, analyze data, and produce content faster. But your personality, experience, and unique perspective are what make your brand memorable.

So remember: understand your audience, create valuable content, stay consistent, and build genuine relationships.

Thanks for listening, and I'll see you in the next episode!

title: The Conquest of Happiness
author: Bertrand Russell
description:
Bertrand Russell confronts the age-old question: What truly brings happiness? In "Conquest of Happiness," he dismantles the myths that cloud our understanding of joy and fulfillment. Through a candid exploration of human emotions, societal pressures, and personal choices, Russell invites listeners on a journey to discover what it means to lead a happy life.

He examines the sources of unhappiness that plague many—such as envy, fear, and the relentless pursuit of success—while offering practical advice to overcome these obstacles. By weaving in his own experiences and observations, Russell provides a relatable perspective that resonates with anyone seeking purpose and contentment.

This audiobook doesn’t shy away from the tough questions. Can we find happiness in a chaotic world? How does our mindset shape our experiences? Russell’s insights lead listeners to reflect on their values, aspirations, and the importance of genuine connections with others.

Engaging, thought-provoking, and full of wisdom, "Conquest of Happiness" serves as a guide for those ready to challenge their beliefs and embrace a more fulfilling life. Whether you’re a philosophy enthusiast or simply someone seeking deeper understanding, this audiobook will spark curiosity and inspire change, making it a must-listen for anyone on the quest for happiness.

title: The Love of Recovery

description:
The Love of Recovery is about something deeper than any one addiction, problem, or circumstance. It is about the human condition itself—self-centeredness, the ego, and shame—and the possibility of living differently.

Hosted by Paul Stecher, author of The Love of Recovery, the podcast explores a practical path built on awareness, acceptance, and action. Through personal experience, recovery, psychology, philosophy, spirituality, and the daily practice of twelve attributes of love, we explore how lasting change occurs not simply by thinking differently, but by practicing a different way of living.

The goal is simple: the act of learning how to love is an act of love.

If you came looking for a tool, you may find something else along the way: a mirror.

author: Lois
description:
Real conversations about what actually lasts.


I don't have children to carry my name forward. What happens to what you've built when there's no obvious person to leave it to? That question is what led me into the real work of legacy - not just wills and trust documents, but the identity, governance, and shared purpose that determine whether what you've built survives into the next generation.


On Legacy Starts with Dirt, I'm using my own family's Montana land as the test case: three sisters, one deed, and real questions about what's fair - worked through using the Living Legacy Tree framework. This podcast is for retiring executives, land-owning families, and anyone who wants the next generation to inherit more than just the assets.

The Pipeline follows that bet through the public record, from the record 541,000-room development pipeline to the fee line it is supposed to feed: what got signed, what actually opened, what each new unit earns, and whether the capital coming back to shareholders is keeping honest company with the cash the fees throw off. Welcome to The Healthy Smile Podcast, where we discuss simple and practical ways to maintain healthy teeth and gums. Today, we're talking about five habits that can make a big difference to your oral health.

1. Brush Twice a Day
Brush your teeth twice a day using fluoride toothpaste. Spend around two minutes brushing and make sure you clean all surfaces of your teeth.

2. Floss Every Day
Flossing helps remove plaque and food particles from between your teeth where a toothbrush cannot reach effectively.

3. Limit Sugary Foods and Drinks
Reducing frequent sugary snacks and drinks can help lower your risk of tooth decay. Water is a great everyday choice for staying hydrated.

4. Visit a Dentist Regularly
Regular dental checkups can help identify potential problems early. If you're looking for professional dental care, choosing the best dentist for your needs can help you maintain your oral health with personalized advice and treatment.

5. Don't Ignore Dental Problems
Tooth pain, bleeding gums, swelling, persistent bad breath, or sensitivity can be signs of an underlying dental issue. Speak with a qualified dental professional if these symptoms continue.

For more information about dental care and services, visit:

Thanks for listening to The Healthy Smile Podcast. Keep smiling and take care of your teeth!

title: The HOA Case Files Podast
author: Kevin B. Leigh and So Shiny Software team
description:
HOA Case Files is the weekly podcast for people who said yes to a volunteer board and then inherited the building, the bank account, and the neighbor who replies-all.

We cover condos, homeowners associations, co-ops, mobile home parks and resident-owned communities, marinas, camp parks, and deed-restricted neighborhoods. Same job, different roof: collect the money, keep the place standing, tell owners the truth, and do it without turning every Tuesday into a deposition.

Each episode starts with a real case. A news story, a court filing, a reserve surprise, a vendor invoice that should never have cleared, a meeting that went sideways, an owner fight that ate six months. We walk through what happened in plain English. Then we argue the only three questions that matter to a volunteer director:

  • What did it actually cost — money, time, and goodwill?
  • What was the risk if the board did nothing?
  • Was the fight worth it?

We do not do legal fog. We are not your attorney, and we will not pretend a statute citation is the same thing as a plan. We talk like treasurers and presidents who still have a day job: assessments, roofs, docks, reserves, work orders, minutes, elections, and the vendor who always has one more change order.

When a story turns on process — invoices nobody matched, minutes nobody can find, a vendor with no certificate of insurance, a vote that lived in someone’s inbox — we say so. That is also where SoShiny lives in the show: not as a commercial, as the counterfactual. What would a real ledger, a payable that needs two eyes, a work order with photos, or a searchable set of CC&Rs have changed? Sometimes the answer is “not much.” We say that too.

If you sit on a self-managed board and you want interesting plus useful — a story you can tell at the next meeting and a checklist you can run on Monday — this is the show.

From the team at SoShiny.com. Association software for boards that want less paperwork and fewer surprises.

title: Why our mind create scenarios
author: Sanan
description:
Why Our Mind Creates Scenarios That Haven’t Happened

Have you ever imagined an entire conversation before it actually happened, worried about something that might never happen, or replayed a situation in your head with countless possible outcomes?

Our minds are constantly trying to predict the future, prepare for uncertainty, and protect us from potential problems. But sometimes, this ability goes too far, turning simple thoughts into detailed scenarios that exist only in our imagination.

In this episode, we explore why our brain creates these imaginary situations, how overthinking and anxiety can fuel them, and why our minds sometimes treat possibilities as if they were reality.

Understanding this process can help us recognize when we're preparing for something—and when we're simply getting lost in our own thoughts.

Ten thousand years ago, humans lived differently. Before the era of kings, borders, and ownership, we were cooperative and deeply connected. We had enough.

This podcast is an inquiry into that change. Was it inevitable? What was lost? And most importantly: can we get any of it back?

description: Bitcoin Field Notes is a research podcast for people who want Bitcoin analysis with receipts. Each episode unpacks one question — security budgets, fee markets, mining economics, privacy heuristics — using primary sources, traceable numbers, and falsifiable predictions. No price calls, no tribalism, no hype. Just the economics hiding under the protocol, explained clearly enough to argue with. If you've ever wondered what the data actually says — and where the consensus narrative breaks — start here. New episodes follow the Field Notes newsletter.

title: Enter Sandman
author: Hat Mode
description:
Join See Podcast's Sam and Jack as they undertake the most perilous journey anyone can do - watching every Adam Sandler/Happy Madison movie.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Lady Couch Podcast
author: The Lady Couch Podcast
description:
🤍 Welcome to The Lady Couch Podcast.
We’re so excited you’re here.
This podcast was created to be more than just something you listen to it’s a place where individuals can come together for honest conversations rooted in God’s Word.
Our prayer is that every episode leaves you feeling encouraged, challenged, and reminded that Jesus is always enough.

description: Exploring the horizon of curiosity.

title: The Omegro Effect: EAM Unlocked
author: Omegro
description:
Humble. Hungry. Smart.
Welcome to The Omegro Effect
Each episode, we speak with founders, CEOs, and M&A leaders about what it takes to build and scale lasting software businesses.
From practical lessons to real operator stories, we'll explore what drives growth, what makes businesses stronger, and with our AI first People led approach, how the right owner can help performance compound.
Let’s get into it.

title: Delightful Diversions
author: Noel
description: Welcome to Delightful Diversions, the podcast that celebrates the joy of cherishing life's little treasures and spreading positivity through the simple pleasures it offers. Join Noel as he embarks on a heartwarming journey through the lens of two best friends who find happiness in the most unexpected places.

title: Delight In Hardship
author: Trace Urquhart
description:
Sharing raw and authentic stories of faith, suffering, and perseverance that point people to the hope and love of Jesus. 
This podcast acts as a bridge but is not the destination.
No matter how far you've wandered, or how much heartache you’ve experienced Jesus is waiting with open arms to fill your heart with peace, joy, and unconditional love. Come back to Him.
These are the conversations I desire and love to have. Thank you for being here.

title: Hotelier Helpcast
author: Gerry MacPherson
description:
Hotelier Helpcast is the practical hotel management podcast for independent hotel owners who want more bookings, stronger profits, smoother operations and less day-to-day chaos.

Hosted by hospitality professional Gerry MacPherson, each episode answers a real question independent hotel owners face when running and growing their properties.

You'll discover practical strategies for hotel management, revenue management, pricing, direct bookings, hotel marketing, guest experience, housekeeping, staff training, maintenance, reviews, technology, AI and hotel operations.

Whether you're running an independent hotel today, preparing to open one, or looking for ways to improve an established property, Hotelier Helpcast gives you straightforward ideas you can adapt and put to work.

No corporate theory. No unnecessary jargon. Just practical hospitality advice designed for independent hotel owners.
New episodes each week.

Follow Hotelier Helpcast and start building a more profitable, organised and guest-focused hotel — without the chaos.

title: Busy Season
author: GoBIG Systems
description: Slow months are a marketing problem, not a season. Busy Season is a show for local service business owners who want the phone ringing year round. Marketing, lead generation, hiring, pricing, and the operations behind steady growth for contractors, roofers, HVAC and plumbing companies, dentists, med spas, law firms, and more. Local SEO, Google Business Profile, reviews, social media, paid ads, and websites that convert, plus the business decisions owners face at every stage. Hosted by GoBIG Systems co-founders Steven Fletcher and Jack Tulloch.

title: Mindless Monday
author: Ki Meishon
description:
Welcome to Mind(less) Monday, a space to breathe, feel, and remember who you are underneath the noise.
I’m Ki — an oracle, creative, and intentional woman devoted to living with awareness and helping the collective heal through truth. Each week, I share reflections and real-life moments that invite you to slow down, regulate, and reprogram the stories that no longer serve you. We talk energy, emotion, and evolution; the kind that starts within and ripples outward. Because the most mindful thing you can do… is learn to be mind-less.

title: FYP: For You Podcast
author: Qs School
description: FYP: For You Podcast is a story-driven educational podcast hosted by Q and presented by Qs School. Like a For You Page filled with content worth your time, each episode brings students a fascinating story from history, psychology, science, culture, wellbeing, or current affairs. We begin with what happened, look beneath the surface, and finish with a bigger question about ourselves and the world.

title: The Unofficial Sage 100 Podcast
author: Jessica
description:
The Unofficial Sage 100 Podcast is for the people who live in Sage 100 every day: users, consultants, partners, and developers supporting businesses behind the scenes. Each episode features real conversations, practical insights, workflow tips, partner perspectives, and honest discussions about everyday wins, challenges, upgrades, and workarounds within the Sage 100 ecosystem.
This podcast is not affiliated with or endorsed by Sage. It is an independent, community-driven show created for professionals who understand that Sage 100 is more than software, it’s how work gets done.

title: LandFans™ Podcast
author: LandFans
description: The LandFans™ Podcast is for Land Flippers, Developers, Wholesalers, and fans of all things Land!

title: UnMother Me
author: Ky
description:
Who are you becoming?

UnMother Me is a podcast about becoming human, real conversations on identity, self-leadership, and what it means to lead yourself well in a world being reshaped by AI. Each episode explores the moments when women, leaders, and founders let go of survival, performance, and self-sacrifice to step into something more sovereign and self-led.

This is the podcast home of The Path of Becoming™, a self-leadership method for anyone navigating the gap between who they've been and who this moment is asking them to become. Expect honest conversations, no scripts, and no easy answers, just the real work of becoming.

New episodes drop weekly. Subscribe and take The Path of Becoming Assessment to find out where you are on the path.

title: Life Of A Female Tradie
author: Laura Faux
description:
Real stories. Real tools. Real women.

Welcome to Life Of A Female Tradie — the podcast that gives voice to the women breaking ground in the trades. We share the honest, gritty, and inspiring journeys of female tradies thriving in a male-dominated industry.

Each episode features real conversations with women in construction and the skilled trades, tackling topics like apprenticeships, jobsite culture, career progression, mental health, physical demands, tools of the trade, and what it really takes to build a future in the field.

Whether you’re already on the tools, just getting started, or curious about what it’s like to be a woman in the trades — this podcast is your crew. We’re building each other up and breaking barriers with every episode.

title: Faith and Tech Podcast
author: French’nette Bryant
description:
Faith and Tech with French’nette Bryant is a podcast where faith, wisdom, leadership, and innovation come together. Each episode explores how believers, leaders, entrepreneurs, and everyday people can understand and use artificial intelligence and emerging technology with wisdom, purpose, integrity, and confidence.
Through practical teaching, inspiring conversations, and faith-centered insight, French’nette helps listeners navigate the changing world of technology without losing sight of their values, purpose, or God-given assignment.
Expect conversations on AI literacy, leadership, business, ministry, responsible technology, personal growth, and the future of innovation.
Faith. Wisdom. Innovation. Impact.

title: Chozen’s Place
author: Charles Chism
description:
Welcome to Chozen’s Place: Feasting On God’s Word — an unfiltered, verse-by-verse journey into Sacred Scripture designed to build unshakeable faith, foster true biblical unity, and equip believers to walk in the power of the Holy Spirit.

Faith is more than intellectual knowledge; it is a living commitment that produces tangible spiritual fruit. Hosted by Chozen, this podcast breaks down deep scriptural doctrine, original Greek and Hebrew insights, and practical Christian living. From uncovering the ministry of the Holy Spirit across redemptive history to guarding the heart against worldly divisions, each episode cuts through surface-level religion to help you feast on the truth of God’s Word, wear your badge of faith with authority, and stand firm on the narrow path.

Whether you are seeking clarity on foundational scripture, desiring a deeper relationship with Jesus Christ, or looking to be equipped for daily spiritual warfare, pull up a seat at the table. It’s time to stop surviving on spiritual milk and start feasting on God’s Word.

title: Songs That Travel Through Time
author: Karen Smith-Gratto
description: This podcast gives a brief history of a traditional song, provides an example performance with Appalachian dulcimer and the website gives links to a variety of sources.

title: The Good AI Podcast
author: The Good AI Podcast
description: A podcast that helps leaders and professionals understand where AI can go wrong - and how to get it right. We explore the risks, mistakes, legal questions, and business challenges behind AI implementation, while building practical AI literacy and helping listeners move toward true AI fluency.

title: Queer Uncharted
author: The Arcane Storyteller
description: Queer Uncharted explores the hidden histories, forgotten voices, and transformative ideas that have shaped LGBTQ+ communities and the wider world. From erased archives and landmark court cases to queer theory, identity, psychology, and social movements, each episode combines rigorous research with thoughtful storytelling. More than a history of queer lives, this is a journey through the people, ideas, and moments that changed how we understand identity, equality, and belonging.

title: BHN Talk & $hop
author: Black Headline News
description: BHN Talk & $hop shows are every Saturday from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM PDT.  Up to six business owners are featured per 2-hr. show; during each 15-minute slot, business owners tell viewers about their business and how they got started.

title: ECS4Kids - The Kids’ Table
author: ECS4Kids
description: Welcome to The Kids Table, where we talk about helping children learn, grow, and thrive. Hosted by Brady Koch, Vice President of Communications at ECS4Kids, each episode sits down with parents, educators, and experts to explore what kids need most: at school, at home, and in the community. Real stories, practical insights, and honest conversations for anyone who cares about giving children a strong start.

title: Lovely Stuff!
author: Gary Johnstone
description: Gary Johnstone (aka MexiGary) from one of the UK's busiest covers bands "Three Card Trick" tells funny stories (he thinks) from the point of view of a travelling full time guitarist, singer and songwriter. The podcast often includes guests who work in the same field to share their experiences. It's a must listen for any grassroots working musician, regardless of where you're based. Feel free to contact us if you'd like to be a guest on the podcast.

title: Marketing MADE. For Style-Led Brands
author: Madelene From MADE. Marketing
description:
Not Another Marketing Podcast, Marketing MADE. is the source for fashion, jewellery and style-led brand founders, marketers and in-house teams who are tired of generic marketing advice and ready for strategies that actually work.
Each episode delivers tactical insights and proven strategies that can be implemented immediately.

title: Ace’n
author: Ace’n
description:
Ace’n covers College Football, Madden, and football gaming through gameplay, Road to Glory storylines, challenges, news, and commentary. The channel blends sports gaming with entertaining, creator-driven content for fans of college football, the NFL, and football video games.


SUBSCRIBE: https://www.youtube.com/@acenmedia1


Email or DM for collabs/business inquiries! collabs@acenmedia.com

title: Built Through the Breaking
author: Aliyah Washington
description:
Built Through the Breaking is a Christian podcast about what happens when God meets us in the places that hurt, break, stretch, and change us.
Hosted by Aliyah, a Christian in her 20s sharing her story and what God has shown her through her journey. A space for honest conversations about faith, surrender, healing, purpose, identity, and becoming who God has called you to be.
Sometimes God is building something in you that could only be formed through the process.
You were not broken beyond repair.
You were being built.

The moon, the deep state, ancient aliens — the internet has theories about all of it.
Chaos Theory by iJC picks one obsession per season and goes all in.
Hosted by Jack Collegio.

title: Creative Counsel with Green Evans-Schroeder
author: The Legal Podcast Network (LPN)
description: Creative Counsel with Green Evans-Schroeder is a podcast dedicated to exploring strategic solutions for protecting and advancing the rights of immigrant communities. Hosted by experienced immigration attorneys, the show provides in-depth discussions on current immigration policies, legal challenges, and advocacy strategies. Designed for legal professionals, immigrants, and anyone interested in immigration issues, the podcast offers valuable insights and practical advice. With a focus on clarity and ethics, Creative Counsel with Green Evans-Schroeder aims to empower listeners with the knowledge needed to navigate the complex world of immigration law.

title: withHASHEM
author: Hosted by: Shlomo Robert Reichmann and Rabbi Josh Kaller
description:
The withHASHEM Podcast
He is not far away. He is within us.
Conversations about understanding Hashem, this world, and our relationship within it.

title: Behind The Test
author: Target English CB
description:
Behind the Test, by Fiona Aish and Jo Tomlinson, is a podcast for ELT teachers, test writers, materials developers, and anyone interested in language assessment.

Language testing is a huge field of study, and once you start scratching the surface, it’s easy to find it daunting. Behind the Test gives you a first look at this complex field, breaking themes and issues down and drawing on our experience to connect them to real world contexts.

We don’t have all the answers — spoiler: no one does — but we think testing is worth talking about.

Get in touch: test@target-english.eu

title: Irregular Design Group
author: Irregular Design Group
description: The IDG Podcast, hosted by Chris Rossiter and Sean Bernstein, is Irregular Design Group's podcast on suppressor engineering, 2A industry news, and straight talk with guest engineers, dealers, and shooters. Episodes dig into material science, design philosophy, dealer strategy, training, and policy shifts shaping the firearms world. Built for shooters who want to know why gear performs the way it does, not just how it looks. New episodes drop regularly, covering everything from metallurgy to competitive shooting to the business side of the industry.

title: QMA’s Sovereign Voices Podcast Series

QMA’s Sovereign Voices Podcast Series

We explore what it truly means to be labeled a “foreign agent”

description: Chronicles of how a person found their true selves through an unforeseen journey of shocking pain, devastating betrayals, abuse leading to acceptance of harsh truths, healing, and finally, evolution.

title: Good Fences Podcast
author: Briana
description:
Real neighbors. Real stories. You be the judge.
Welcome to Good Fences Podcast, where we tell the stories that happen on the other side of the fence—from hilarious encounters and neighborhood drama to the completely unbelievable.
Every story ends with one question: Fence or No Fence?
You hear the story. You make the call. Then the neighborhood votes.
Have a neighbor story of your own? Send it to goodfacespod@gmail.com

Moving to Germany is the easy part. Surviving the bureaucracy, decoding the culture, and actually thriving here is the real test.

author: John Stanko & Craig Smith Jr.
description: Join two lifelong friends—30 years and counting—as we navigate the highs, lows, and hilarities of life. From deep dives into thought-provoking topics to off-the-cuff jokes that only decades of friendship can produce, we bring you real talk, raw laughter, and stories that resonate. Whether we’re reminiscing about the past or dissecting the present, there’s always something to learn, laugh about, or reflect on. So pull up a chair, grab your drink of choice, and let’s get into it

title: The Moot Tree
author: Jason Gregg
description:
The Moot Tree is about lawful personal independence, stronger communities, self-reliance and thoughtful participation in society. Not just commentary, you'll discover ways to improve your life by setting goals, accepting challenges and controlling outcomes.
This is about regaining control, slipping the bonds of big business, power politics and oppressive regulation. It does not advocate ignoring the law, refusing legitimate obligations, overthrowing government, violence, or the legal theories associated with the sovereign citizen movement.
Our subject is personal sovereignty through responsibility.

title: Truth Hertz
author: Giovanni
description: Too often the voices of truth and logic are drowned out by the loud and misleading lifestyles that this decaying world has to offer. Level the playing field by shedding a brighter light on household/personal topics via God's holy scriptures.

title: Overton Radio Podcast

description:
Go behind the scenes with the Overton Radio Podcast, where we lift the lid on the station, the people who make it happen, and the stories that make our community so special.
Hear what really goes on behind the microphone, discover the stories behind your favourite shows, enjoy special features and exclusive conversations, and meet local residents with fascinating stories to tell.

author: Frank Dolce, Alema Harrington
description: Join Frank Dolce and Alema Harrington weekly for “Red and Blue,” not only the definitive Podcast about a rivalry that defines the State of Utah, but the most insightful and entertaining look at the world of collegiate athletics and the culture of Sport.

title: Butterfly Within: The Experience
author: Shurnettarenee
description: Butterfly Within: The Experience is a space for honest conversations about healing, growth, and transformation from the inside out. This podcast is for those navigating life’s transitions, sitting with their emotions, and learning to honor their journey even when it feels uncomfortable or uncertain. Through reflection and real-life experiences, Butterfly Within invites you to slow down, turn inward, and trust the process of becoming.

title: The Accidental Sales Strategist
author: Prashant Uttekar
description: Most people never choose sales. They fall into it by accident and one day realise they are actually quite good at something they never meant to do. This show is the story of that moment, and the framework hiding inside it

title: The Salt Company Syracuse
author: Salt Company Syracuse
description: The Salt Company is a collegiate ministry in Syracuse, NY under the direction of Radiant Church and The Salt Network.

title: Refined by Fire
author: TaRay Riley
description: From the concrete of Chicago to the redemption of the Midwest, Refined by Fire explores the raw journey of transforming a "draft" life into an intended one. Join Taray T. Riley as he translates hard-earned lessons from his years as a fugitive and hustler into powerful wisdom for becoming a better man, father, and leader.

title: Refined Misfit Podcast
author: Refined Misfit
description: Life doesn’t always go according to plan. Refined Misfit is a faith-based podcast where real people share the stories behind the struggles, the trials, setbacks, breakthroughs, and moments that changed everything. Through honest testimonies and conversations, we talk about faith, identity, relationships, purpose, redemption, and the messy realities of life. Because even the seasons we wish we could erase can be used by God to refine us into who He created us to be.

title: Ship It! Archive

description: Archived copies of Ship It! Show

description: Unlimited Minutes Is a podcast by two brothers Ivory & Ted covering current affairs, pop culture, sports, music, politics ,crime and the justice system

description: Furry Podcast with Frostbyte & Morningstar. Two furs and pups, and drunks who have no idea what they're doing.  Frostbytesnep.com for more information.

title: The Game's Afoot - A History of the English Fictional Detective
author: NaxosAudiobooks
description: Crime fiction is now one of the world's most popular literary genres, with annual book sales running into millions. This four-part podcast traces the origins of the fictional detective in English Literature from the mid- 19th century  up to the outbreak  of World War 2  and features  excerpts from many favourite detective novels  from the Naxos AudioBooks catalogue.

title: The Family Reserve
author: Joseph Di Guilio
description: The Family Reserve is a no-nonsense guide to protecting and building your family's wealth. Hosted by Joe DiGiulio, each episode breaks down the financial tools most people misunderstand — life insurance, retirement accounts, cash value, and long-term planning — in plain English. Whether you're weighing term vs. permanent coverage, saving for a child's education, or building retirement income, Joe reframes money decisions around what actually matters: the people you're providing for. Practical, myth-busting conversations to help you make confident choices about your family's financial future.

title: Biz Club Besties
author: MO
description:
Move over girls' night and book clubs...Besties Biz Clubs have entered the chat!

Just a group of friends pursuing our passions, exploring business ideas and finally taking action..over delicious bevies & bites, of course!!

title: Serial Killers and Side Quests
author: Jayme
description: Serial Killers and Side Quests is a true-crime podcast where one host keeps the story on track and the other immediately wanders off it. My wife dives into the chilling lives, crimes, and psychology of history's most notorious killers, while I interrupt with random facts, bizarre connections, and completely unexpected tangents. Come for the murder, stay for the side quests - because getting distracted has never been this entertaining.

title: Little Whispers
author: Eniolanimi
description:
Born out of my love for Journaling. Little Whispers is a collection of my thoughts from my journal out to you. 
Everytime I go through my archives of writings, I realize I write so much about myself, my growth, struggles and wins and more often, my conversations with the Holy Spirit and now is the time to share them with you. Hopefully, each episode speaks to you. 
 I'm Eniolanimi, a Brand Strategist, Niche Analyst and Storyteller. 
 
Whether I'm talking about Brand Strategy, my intimacy with God, , love for Food, Books, Music, Building COTA, or as I grow through life,
Be inspired to be YOU

title: Emotional Biohacking with Dr. Etel Leit
author: Dr. Etel Leit
description:
Dr. Etel Leit - known as Your Love Doctor - is a TEDx speaker, professor of psychology, five-time author, and relationship strategist who helps people unlock what they actually crave: love that excites, intimacy that feels alive, and communication that truly lands.
For over 20 years, she’s coached singles, couples, and high-achievers around the world to break free from toxic patterns, codependency, and unhealthy relationship cycles. Her work blends science, storytelling, and practical tools, teaching how the same patterns lead to our success at work.
Etel is the founder of SignShine™ Beverly Hills, has been featured on CNN, NBC, FOX, KTLA, and WEtv. A former commander in Israeli Intelligence, she holds a Master’s in Leadership & Education from Pepperdine University and a Ph.D. in Positive & Transpersonal Psychology.

title: Success in a Neurodiverse World
author: Bobby Armstrong
description: What if we stopped letting labels define our potential? Success in a Neurodiverse World goes beyond diagnoses to focus on genuine relationships, practical advocacy, and real-life growth. Whether you are navigating your own path, raising a neurodivergent child, or simply supporting someone you love, our candid interviews and actionable resources will empower you. Follow along to turn demanding challenges into lasting strengths and redefine what genuine success looks like for you.

title: Mango Diaries Podcast
author: Alison and Michael
description:
Mango Diaries Podcast exists to inspire and equip people to step out of their comfort zones and take faith-filled risks with Jesus. 

Join us each week as we learn from people across the world making a difference in their communities. 

Whether you're wrestling with a big decision, thinking about making a change, or just wanting to live a more intentional life, this podcast is for you.

title: The Breath of Fresh Air Podcast
author: Dante P. Johnson
description: Fresh Perspective and Reflective Guidance that Breathes Life into You.

title: Lost in Expression
author: Bruce
description: Lost in Expression is a podcast about trying to say what I actually mean.

title: Canadian Model Horse History Podcast
author: SelectArcane
description: A podcast that focuses on the Canadian side of the model horse hobby.

title: BlueOrange HUSH
author: BlueOrange HUSH
description: A quiet space for meditation, relaxation, and better sleep. Slow down, breathe, and find your moment of calm with BlueOrange HUSH.

title: Everybody Loves a Sandwich
author: Dan, Scott, and Max
description:
Everybody Loves a Sandwich is what happens when three friends, financial advisors, sports fans, and bourbon enthusiasts sit down around a table with hot wings and microphones.

Dan, Scott, and Max talk sports, life, family, bourbon, money, and whatever rabbit holes find their way into the conversation. And because every good sandwich needs something in the middle, each episode sandwiches in a little practical financial conversation along the way.

No stuffy financial lectures. No pretending we have all the answers. Just three guys, good conversation, plenty of opinions, and a little something to chew on.

Pull up a chair. Everybody Loves a Sandwich.

title: Cracked Catholics
author: Gena Brown
description: Cracked Catholics is a podcast that is for those who are a little cracked— Catholics (or anyone) who is trying hold true to their faith while balancing it all and trying not to lose it in the school carline.

title: Best Life Pending with Steph De Sousa & Chrissy Hearn
author: Podshape
description:
Best Life Pending is a podcast for women over 40 who are done pretending they have it all figured out. We're here for the career pivots, the messy divorces, the friendships that end without warning, and the hot flushes nobody prepared us for. No filters, no fake positivity, no pretending aging is a graceful glide into irrelevance. 
Every week, we take the conversations women usually only have after two glasses of wine and put them on the record: funny, honest, occasionally uncomfortable, always real. We're not here to fix you. You're not broken. We're here to remind you that reinvention doesn't have an age limit, and neither does laughing at yourself.

title: For the Good of All with Lorenzo Chambers
author: Lorenzo Alexander Chambers
description: Join Lorenzo Chambers as he explores ideas that challenge us, conversations that inspire us, and solutions that bring us closer together, through the lens of understanding, responsibility, and hope.

title: Forever Sergeant Reads Old Sh*t
author: ForeverSergeantUSAF
description:
I, TSgt Chris Reynolds, USAF (Ret) served from 2001-2021 and I am lover of all things history, I think because I was born without a name and raised by a family that was not mine by blood. Since then I have gone through many crazy times, ups and downs and have come to the realization that my core values are Curiosity, Empathy, and Integrity.
With this channel I hope to bring old things that people wrote to life through critical analysis, relating to the people then and now, and sharing my love of our human story with others.

title: Second Wind
author: Leaflet Studio
description:
Ossurus is a strange, dangerous world shaped by the corpses of colossal titans that fall from the heavens as regularly as the seasons change. 

Cities rise within their ribcages. Cultures flourish in the shadows of ancient remains. Forests, storms, mutations, and impossible magical phenomena bloom where titanic power lingers in bone, blood, and earth.

The Second Wind Podcast is a D&D actual-play where the DM seat rotates every season, giving each story arc its own voice, style, mysteries, and unique set of wonderfully questionable decisions.

We love epic fantasy, deep worldbuilding, memorable characters, and letting the dice turn carefully laid plans into glorious nonsense!

title: Barking @ Butterflies
author: Steven Clements
description: Barking at Butterflies speaks to the way we sometimes chase, question, or react to the small moments in life that carry a bigger meaning. The butterfly represents change, growth, and transformation, while barking suggests the noise, confusion, and strong reactions we bring to situations we don’t always understand. This podcast is about slowing down long enough to listen and learn. It’s built around sensible conversations about life strategies, personal choices, and the lessons learned along the way. Through honest discussions with moms, dads, friends, seniors, prison inmates, and everyday people, each episode explores the pitfalls of life, the hurdles we face, and the strategies we use to make the right call. From honest stories and different perspectives, the podcast offers practical wisdom for how to navigate life through incrementalism.
